items.title: Italy’s WeRoad Lets Korean Superapp NOL Own Its Customers: Exclusive
items.summary: WeRoad is entering South Korea without selling a single trip directly, letting NOL own the customer. If it works, it could become the template for how Western tour operators get into Asia.

items.title: Accor’s Largest Shareholder Moves to Oust CEO After Ennismore Buyout
items.summary: Parvus, an activist investor, has criticized Accor's Ennismore buyout and 13 years of alleged stock price underperformance under CEO Sébastien Bazin. Accor's management has its own side to the story.

items.title: Lufthansa to Cut 1,000 Jobs
items.summary: Job cuts won’t fix Lufthansa Airlines — its own board says it’s uncompetitive on cost, efficiency and productivity.

items.title: Airbnb Floats Price-Matching: A Skift Test Shows Where Direct Booking Wins
items.summary: Are we one day going to see an Airbnb best price guarantee for short-term rentals? AI agents may force the issue.

items.title: Saudi Arabia’s Diriyah Scraps $191 Million Hotel Build
items.summary: Diriyah has canceled a $191 million hotel contract and won’t say why. It’s the first Saudi hotel project known to be pulled since the Houthi strikes on Riyadh, and it comes from one of the few giga-projects still spending.

items.title: Selar Wants to Make Arctic Cruising Less Like a Cruise
items.summary: Selar is pairing a lower-emissions ship with small groups, local expertise, and a different idea of expedition luxury. Its opportunity is to make a lighter footprint part of a better experience, rather than simply another sustainability claim.

items.title: Oil Spills Affect UAE, Oman Beaches as Hormuz Strikes Go On
items.summary: Beach access on the UAE’s east coast and northern emirates now depends on local notices that can change with each tanker strike. That’s a risk Dubai and Abu Dhabi don’t carry yet.

items.title: Airport Shutdown Wiped 65% Off Riyadh Hotel RevPAR in October
items.summary: Riyadh’s hotels lost their peak season when the airport shut. With BA, Cathay Pacific and others suspended into the new year and Houthi strikes still hitting the capital, the recovery hasn’t started.
